Capstone Simulation

The Nexus Brief

An end-to-end operational transformation of Nexus Creative Hub, a boutique digital marketing agency, from chaos to scale, completed as Aisha's final certification project.

CLIENT: Amara Osei-Bonsu, Founder
AGENCY: Nexus Creative Hub, Lagos
SCOPE: 8 team members · 11 global accounts
MARKETS: Nigeria · United Kingdom · United States
01Client

Meet Amara

Amara Osei-Bonsu is a 34-year-old Nigerian-Ghanaian entrepreneur based in Victoria Island, Lagos. In 2021 she founded Nexus Creative Hub, a fast-growing agency offering social media management, content strategy, brand identity, and high-ROI paid advertising.

Scale

Supported by 8 team members, serving 11 active accounts across Nigeria, the UK, and the US.

The pain point

Brilliant and energetic, yet overwhelmed. Micromanaging too many operations, scattered folders, an inbox she called a "daily war zone."

02Challenge

The chaotic intake brief

Raw communication intake

7:14am Monday: Amara sent a rapid-fire, unstructured 1-minute-43 WhatsApp voice note detailing overlapping administrative demands, with no formal onboarding, no file structure, and instructions scattered.

Backlog breakdown

A disorganized inbox, conflicting calendar bookings, missing competitor metrics, and an unconfigured onboarding pipeline, with a single objective: turn raw chaos into secure, structured operating processes.

03Triage

Day 1: priority & task triage

Eisenhower Matrix

Classified every urgent and strategic request from the voice note, resolving priority paralysis immediately.

Todoist Pipeline

Organized 17 precise tasks with realistic deadlines, reminders, and category tags.

Time-Blocking

Protected dedicated administrative hours for high-focus processing.

Slack Standard

Wrote a Monday stand-up update to align all 8 team members instantly.

04Inbox

Inbox triage & priorities

Structural labeling

  • Team-internal, communication from the 8 core members
  • Urgent-UK Clients, high priority, including Sarah's escalated thread
  • US Client-TechVault, direct tracking for Marcus's account
  • Vendors and Tools, invoices and subscription records

Drafts executed

  • Sarah (London): content calendar update, drafted with diplomacy
  • Canva Enterprise: licensing limits and tier upgrade proposal
  • Zara (Team Lead): professional acknowledgement, loop closed
  • Marcus (TechVault): vague feedback clarified via query tables
05Calendar

Calendar systems & booking flow

Conflict resolution

Audited overlapping Thursday schedules and sent a professional rescheduling email to Team Lead Zara, preserving trust and clear coordination.

Embedded booking gateway

Configured a dedicated Calendly pipeline with buffers and alerts, embedded into a centralized Google Sites workspace, restoring 4+ hours a week to the CEO's calendar.

File architecture & system redesign
